# uptimekuma_proxy (Resource)

Proxy resource for managing HTTP/HTTPS/SOCKS proxies in Uptime Kuma

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Example 1: Basic HTTP proxy without authentication
resource "uptimekuma_proxy" "http_basic" {
  host     = "proxy.example.com"
  port     = 8080
  protocol = "http"
  active   = true
}

# Example 2: HTTPS proxy with authentication
resource "uptimekuma_proxy" "https_with_auth" {
  host     = "secure-proxy.example.com"
  port     = 8443
  protocol = "https"
  auth     = true
  username = "proxyuser"
  password = "proxypassword"
  active   = true
}

# Example 3: SOCKS5 proxy as default proxy
resource "uptimekuma_proxy" "socks5_default" {
  host     = "socks.example.com"
  port     = 1080
  protocol = "socks5"
  auth     = true
  username = "socksuser"
  password = "sockspass"
  active   = true
  default  = true
}

# Example 4: Proxy with apply_existing flag to apply to all monitors on creation
resource "uptimekuma_proxy" "apply_to_monitors" {
  host           = "new-proxy.example.com"
  port           = 3128
  protocol       = "http"
  active         = true
  apply_existing = true
}

# Example 5: Inactive proxy (disabled)
resource "uptimekuma_proxy" "disabled_proxy" {
  host     = "legacy-proxy.example.com"
  port     = 8080
  protocol = "http"
  active   = false
}

# Requires Terraform or OpenTofu 1.11 or later: password_wo is never stored in
# plan or state. Change password_wo_version whenever the secret changes.
resource "uptimekuma_proxy" "write_only" {
  host     = "proxy.example.com"
  port     = 3128
  protocol = "http"
  auth     = true
  username = "proxyuser"

  password_wo         = "proxy-password"
  password_wo_version = "1"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `host` (String) Proxy server hostname or IP address
- `port` (Number) Proxy server port
- `protocol` (String) Proxy protocol (http, https, or socks5)

### Optional

> **NOTE**: [Write-only arguments](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments) are supported in Terraform 1.11 and later.

- `active` (Boolean) Enable or disable the proxy
- `apply_existing` (Boolean) Apply proxy to all existing monitors on creation
- `auth` (Boolean) Whether proxy authentication is required
- `default` (Boolean) Set as the default proxy
- `password` (String, Sensitive) Password for proxy authentication. Stored in state; use `password_wo` to keep it out of state.
- `password_wo` (String, Sensitive, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) Password for proxy authentication, write-only: sent to Uptime Kuma on create and update but never stored in plan or state. Requires Terraform 1.11 or OpenTofu 1.11 or later. Conflicts with `password`; requires `password_wo_version`. An imported resource has no `password_wo_version` yet, so `terraform import` may store the server's value in `password` until the next apply with `password_wo` set removes it from state.
- `password_wo_version` (String) Any value that changes whenever `password_wo` changes, for example a counter or a hash of the secret's encrypted source. A change triggers an update that sends the current `password_wo`.
- `username` (String) Username for proxy authentication

### Read-Only

- `id` (Number) Proxy identifier
